latin: Rationabiliter posuit Aristoteles in suis scientiis primum principium de quolibet dici alterum contradictoriorum, et de nullo simul.
translation: Aristotle reasonably posited, within his sciences, the first principle that of anything one or the other of two contradictories must be said to hold, and never both of the same thing at once.
translation_note: Restates the law of non-contradiction as Aristotle's first principle within his sciences, distinct from the coincidence of contradictories claimed of the intellectual/unial natures in 3>13-15; sense checked.
